name: Toast Loyalty
oneLiner: Points-based loyalty program built into the Toast restaurant POS, sold within Toast's Marketing Essentials package.
bestFor: Restaurants already running on Toast POS that want loyalty, guest marketing and payments in one system.

updates.text: Spring 2026 release relaunched the Toast Local guest app with loyalty built in: guests see their points balance, find ways to earn and redeem rewards, and operators can push targeted rewards. The app also shows reservations through Resy and Toast Tables.
Toast launched Toast IQ Grow (May 5, 2026), a premium package with an AI Marketing Agent, a Marketing Success Manager and Marketing Essentials (email and SMS marketing, loyalty, gift cards, social).

features: Guest enrollment by phone number, email or linked payment card; linked cards earn points automatically
Bonus rewards such as welcome offers, birthday rewards and double-point promotions
Earning and redemption across Toast POS, online ordering, kiosk, Toast Go handhelds and the Toast Local app
Email and SMS campaigns to loyalty members through Toast Marketing
Loyalty and guest analytics in the Toast dashboard
Points balance and reward redemption in the relaunched Toast Local app
Visit-based or amount-based programs with up to five cash-discount or item rewards
Shared program across locations in a Gift/Rewards Card Group
No cap on points per transaction or on a guest's balance

pricing.text: Toast does not publish a standalone price for Loyalty. You buy it in the Marketing Essentials bundle from Toast Shop, or ask Toast Care to add the standalone Toast Loyalty subscription; pricing is quoted by Toast.

notes: The original review's '$185/month Marketing Essentials' price only appears on third-party sites (loop.fans, StampMe); not confirmed on toasttab.com, so dropped. Toast's '63% more sales' and '39% more spend' claims are vendor data and were not used. Toast Local is the renamed Toast Takeout app. Customer stories (Captain Parker's Pub, Craft Lounge, Kaldi's Coffee) are on Toast's blog; Captain Parker's dates from the COVID-19 period. pos.toasttab.com could not be fetched from this session; facts come from search results. 2026-11: the Toast support article 'Get Started With Toast Loyalty' was opened directly (purchase routes, program types, up to five rewards, one program at a time, no earning on DoorDash, Grubhub or Uber Eats orders, no points cap). No G2 rating: G2 has no Toast Loyalty listing (Toast's 4.2 covers the whole POS).
pros: Built into the Toast POS, so loyalty shares the guest record with orders and payments
Guests join by phone, email or linked card; linked cards earn automatically
Points earn and redeem across the POS, online ordering, kiosk and the Toast Local app
Locations in a Gift/Rewards Card Group share one program
No cap on points per transaction or on a guest's balance

cons.text: Works only for restaurants on Toast POS
No published price; it comes in the Marketing Essentials bundle or as a standalone subscription added by Toast Care
Orders through DoorDash, Grubhub and Uber Eats don't earn or redeem points
One rewards program at a time, with up to five rewards
